description: This Kotlin source file defines a DatabaseHelper class that extends SQLiteOpenHelper to manage a local SQLite database for storing notes. It includes methods to create, read, search, update, and delete notes in the database, facilitating data persistence in an Android application.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: A helper class extending SQLiteOpenHelper to manage CRUD operations for notes in an SQLite database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table and an index on the updatedAt column.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Drops existing notes table and recreates it when database version updates.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for notes where the title or content matches the query string.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a note by its ID.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts a new note or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
